stories.title: Barnwell names future Hall of Famers on every NFL team: Who will ultimately be enshrined?
stories.summary: We went roster by roster to pick out the NFL players who are on track to make the Hall of Fame one day -- and those who still have some work to do.

stories.title: Colts star Taylor latest RB to land big extension
stories.summary: The Colts and Jonathan Taylor have agreed to terms on a two-year, $44 million extension, the star running back's agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Suns keeping Brooks on 3-year, $73M extension
stories.summary: Suns forward Dillon Brooks agreed to a three-year, $73 million contract extension through the 2029-30 season, his agent told ESPN.

stories.title: Jumalon 2nd youngest to win WSOP main event
stories.summary: Lucas Jumalon, a 22-year-old poker pro from Spokane, Washington, beat Finland's Lauri Saaskilahti heads-up to win the 2026 World Series of Poker main event and $10 million.

stories.title: Infantino sorry for 'errors' but gets FIFA backing
stories.summary: FIFA said Wednesday it had apologized for errors made over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and that senior staff in attendance at a summit held in Morocco "reaffirmed their full support" for his presidency.
